name_input: LIEBHERR INDIA PVT. LTD.; LIEBHERR INDIA PVT LTD; M/S LIEBHERR INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; LIEBHERR INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: Liebherr Group (liebherr.com / liebherr.in, accessed 25.11.2026) product programme, which Liebherr India Private Limited sells and services in India: earthmoving (wheeled and crawler excavators, wheel loaders, dozers, articulated dump trucks), material handling (reachstackers, ship cranes, port equipment), deep foundation (rotary drilling rigs, piling rigs, diaphragm wall cutters), mining (large hydraulic excavators, mining trucks), concrete technology (truck mixers, batching plants, concrete pumps), tower cranes, mobile and crawler cranes, maritime cranes, aerospace and transportation systems, gear technology and automation systems, components (hydraulics, slewing bearings, drive technology), refrigeration and freezing (domestic and commercial refrigerators/freezers), hotels. Liebherr India's own site (liebherr.in) redirects to the Group corporate site and lists the same product segments; no separate India-specific catalogue page could be retrieved within the tool budget, so the India entity's exact SKU mix is not independently documented here.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — Liebherr India Private Limited is the Indian sales/service and partly assembly arm of the German Liebherr Group (manufacturer parent), acting as importer/distributor of Group-built machinery plus local assembly and after-sales; no evidence of independent third-party trading.
comment: HS 847160 ("units of automatic data-processing machines, input or output") is wrong for this company. Liebherr is a construction/mining/materials-handling/refrigeration equipment maker; its Indian entity sells excavators, cranes, drilling rigs, concrete equipment, components and refrigerators. Correct HS-6 families: 8429 (self-propelled dozers, graders, scrapers, excavators, loaders, tamping machines) — core; 8426 (cranes, ship cranes, straddle carriers); 8426 20 tower cranes; 8429 52 crawler excavators; 8429 59 other excavators/loaders; 8431 49 / 8431 41 parts of 8426/8429/8427 machinery; 8474 31/8474 32/8474 90 concrete mixers, batching plants and parts; 8479 10 road-making machinery; 8418 61/8418 69 refrigerating/freezing equipment (Liebherr Hausgeräte line); 8483 (gears, gearboxes, slewing rings, drive shafts) and 8482 (bearings) for the components segment; 8704 10/8704 21 for dump trucks where road-going; 8412 21/8412 29 hydraulic cylinders and motors. Industry classification "IT и электроника" is a misclassification: the declared HS 847160 and the IT label appear to be a data-entry artefact (possibly a generic/incorrect code carried over from a broker's list), not a description of Liebherr's business. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection — the company stays in the base and the code is corrected; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note: no customs line was available to this researcher (registry/customs research out of scope for this role), therefore the specific HS codes above are derived from the public product programme and are marked "заявлено, не подтверждено" as to actual shipment lines; the product range itself is corroborated by the corporate site. Trader signs: Liebherr India imports Group-manufactured machines and sells/services them locally — an import-distribution pattern typical of a manufacturer's own subsidiary, not an independent trader; the declared 847160 line shows no trader/IT product line at all, and the entire machinery, components and refrigeration product lines are missing from the declaration.
